localComparison.method: The same 84 named pairs and all 260 PNG identities are compared. Local/CI SHA256 or raster differences are informational because Chromium patch versions and surrounding unmigrated content can differ. Each CI pair independently must satisfy the existing within-run geometry and screenshot thresholds. No cross-browser byte identity is assumed.

pixelVerification: All PNGs are decoded and verified. The 84 source/published RGB comparisons are independently recomputed at channel difference greater than 24 and must exactly equal the report counts/ratios, as well as satisfy the existing 0.01 changed-ratio gate.
retainedIdentityLimit: Every retained sourceCommit or CI commit field is required to match this commit. Source UI and shape reports do not expose their own commit field; their file hashes and artifact/run provenance are recorded without inventing one. The separate focus gate reports through workflow exit status and screenshots, not a standalone JSON report.
limits: Chromium automation, emulated touch and targeted discovery-text enlargement. This is not native browser zoom, cross-browser, physical-device or accessibility certification. Inherited enlargement findings remain distinct from migration parity. Pricing and external product behaviour are outside this bounded gate.
